Thank you both for disclosing this critical information. Ravi, your observation of three heated handoff incidents and Morgan's request to avoid one-to-one meetings with Casey until facilitated repair occurs is exactly the kind of directly observed relationship condition I needed to hear. Please do send me those incident notes right after this meeting. Casey, thank you for sharing your caregiving constraint — a 15:45 pickup means a 15:00–15:30 recurring coordination slot makes sense, and I'll respect your limit of no more than two live coordination meetings per week.

Given what I've heard, here's what I'm considering for the temporary arrangement: Casey continues as direct client liaison, but with a structured handoff process that avoids one-to-one Casey-Morgan interactions for now. I'd like to set the weekly coordination meeting at 15:00–15:30, introduce a standardized handoff template so nothing falls through the cracks across email and chat, and have Ravi or another team member serve as an intermediary for any Casey-Morgan handoffs until we can arrange facilitated repair. I also want to address Morgan's non-attendance at the weekly coordination meeting — that needs to change or we need an alternative.

Before I finalize, are there any other constraints or observations anyone needs to share?
